subject: Clarify DPA Annex: model-use exclusions & proof delivery
messages:
From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@brightcare.com>
To: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.example.com>
Cc: procurement@brightcare.com
Date: 2027-03-14T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: DPA annex questions — no-training & proof artifacts

Hi Ava,

Thanks for the call yesterday. We reviewed the draft DPA and one of our legal reviewers asked for a concrete delivery plan for the "no-training" / "no model improvement" commitments in Annex B. Specifically they want:

- A list of subprocessors that will see customer content and their processing locations (csv is fine).
- A short (1-2 page) operations proof that shows how data is isolated and never flows to model improvement pipelines — e.g., KV cache handling, ephemeral routing, and audit logging we can verify.
- Confirmation about cross-border export options and whether Brightcare can require onshore processing for our EU/US customers.

Can you provide an estimated delivery date for those artifacts? Procurement also asked whether we can sign the amended redlines attached to the DPA if we receive the artifacts before signature.

Appreciate a concrete timeline — our renewal window is tight.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Jensen
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Brightcare, Inc.

--
Attachment: dpa_redlines_v1.docx (docx)

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.example.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@brightcare.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-03-15T08:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: DPA annex questions — no-training & proof artifacts

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. We can deliver all three artifacts; high level plan below and then we can align on the signature timing.

Planned deliverables and ETA:
- Subprocessor inventory (CSV): lists roles, regions, and whether they have access to customer interaction payloads — ETA: 2027-03-16 EOD.
- Operational proof (PDF): 2-page summary + 1 appendix with sample audit log entries and a short architecture diagram showing ephemeral KV routing and model variant guardrails — ETA: 2027-03-17 mid-day.
- Export/residency confirmation: We will include an explicit onshore-processing option and three operational routes (API onshore routing, SFTP export lane, and dedicated VPC deployment checklist) — ETA: 2027-03-17 EOD.

We will produce attachments as stubs in this thread and provide a secure Drive link for full artifacts. If these are acceptable, we can proceed with accepting the redlines and move to signatures (DocuSign) the same week. For procurement's timing: if Brightcare confirms that receipt of the artifacts satisfies the internal review, we can proceed with countersignature the day artifacts are uploaded.

Internal notes: Kim (cc'd) will own the operational proof and coordinate sample logs with David for the onshore routing language.

Next steps:
1) We'll upload the CSV and PDF to a shared Drive folder and send the link to you (and procurement).
2) If you confirm redlines are acceptable pending artifacts, we'll prepare the DocuSign envelope.

Thanks — Ava
Ava Chen
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

--

From: Ava Chen <ava_chen@redwood.example.com>
To: David Kim <david_kim@redwood.example.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.example.com>
Date: 2027-03-16T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Brightcare evidence pack — quick asks

David / Kim — forwarding Sarah's ask and the timeline. Can you each confirm the following by EOD?

David:
- Can we export a one-week sample of audit logs (redacted) that show request routing and KV cache flags for a non-sensitive customer to include in the appendix? We should ensure the sample includes timestamps, route decisions (onshore vs hosted), and cache-control markers.
- Do we have an existing onshore routing playbook for US residents? If not, can you sketch the minimal checklist for the onshore lane (KMS, subnet ACLs, and export suppression)?

Kim:
- I'll need a 2-page operational proof doc: summary + architecture diagram. Can you give me a diagram SVG and bullet list of guardrails? Also confirm whether we can produce a signed attestation template (ops lead signature) to include.

Attachments to prepare: subprocessor_inventory_20270316.csv, onshore_evidence_plan_draft.pdf, sample_audit_rows.txt

Thanks — I'll incorporate and send consolidated Drive link to Sarah once we have those pieces.

Ava
